title: Pats-Hawks fantasy REAX + Week 1 Dynasty Debates: Rookies, 2nd year players to start, sit

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Pats-Hawks fantasy REAX + Week 1 Dynasty Debates: Rookies, 2nd year players to start, sit
sources.description: Nate Tice is back on Wednesdays with Matt Harmon for a revamped show dedicated to the biggest debates in dynasty as well as a look the biggest start, sit questions to answer in Week 1. The two do a deep dive on the rookie class and 2nd year players to see what we can expect in fantasy from them in Week 1 and the month of September. The two also preview the Thursday Night Football game between the 49ers and Rams.
